title: Design exercise: SAA-2.1-S04
scenario: Redwater Tax Software maintains nine server applications, each pinned to a different Java runtime, so a fix that works on a developer laptop keeps failing on the production servers. Two of the nine are vendor builds whose source the company does not hold, and they must move to AWS unchanged. A tenth item is a 40-line nightly script that resizes 200 images from a bucket and sits idle for 23 hours a day. Nobody on the four-person team knows Kubernetes, and nobody wants to patch host operating systems.
constraints: Do not claim live AWS experience
Nobody on the team has Kubernetes experience
The team will not patch or manage host operating systems
The two vendor builds cannot be modified

rubric.label: Each of the nine applications and the nightly script is given a compute choice with a reason drawn from the scenario's figures (runtime pinning, unchanged vendor builds, 23 idle hours a day)
No Kubernetes and no host operating system patching remain in the design

constraint_reason: Mapped as design_exercise to complete skill coverage when no dedicated live lab step exists
